preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

traceable-report.instruction: Organize the report around its purpose, method or basis, findings, and bounded conclusions, with traceable headings and references.

precise-technical-language.instruction: Use consistent technical terminology and define reader-relevant terms without reducing scientific precision.

measurement-integrity.instruction: Preserve quantities, symbols, SI units, measurement conditions, and reported uncertainty; flag missing definitions rather than infer them. Recompute derived quantities from the stated inputs and assumptions before rounding; check the result against the defining relation.

accessible-evidence.instruction: Make figures and tables understandable through descriptive titles, labels, units, captions, and appropriate text alternatives.
